//optionalDependencies: Workaround for npm/cli#4828, which broke CI from commit b764197 (S8) until it was found.
npm records ONLY the current platform's native binaries as installable lockfile entries, so
regenerating the lockfile on macOS silently dropped every Linux binary. The failure mode is
deliberately quiet: `npm ci` on Linux SUCCEEDS having installed no native binding at all, and
the error only appears later as 'Cannot find native binding' during the web build or tests.
Note `npm install` does NOT repair this — it honours the lockfile, so absent entries stay
absent; the entries have to be declared here to exist for any platform.
Each package's own os/cpu constraints mean a machine still installs only the variant it can
use, so this costs a Mac developer nothing. glibc (-gnu/-glibc) variants only: the runtime
image is Debian-based. Versions track the ROOT copy of each package.
